The *Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.13) is a canonical Abhidhamma text forming part of the *Paṭṭhāna* in the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the systematic conditional matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this text addresses the conditional relations connecting the supplementary dyadic categories (*piṭṭhiduka*) with the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus identifies extensive text reuse between this work and other Abhidhamma sections, registering 9,580 matching passages across 321 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial shared materials occur with closely corresponding analytical sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, particularly the *Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.10), the *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13), the *Kusalattika, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 4.7), and the *Saraṇaduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.14) [DharmaNexus].
